title.en: The Barbie angle in this edition
title.zh: 本版的芭比角度

paragraphs.en: Barbie names the angle of looking again at something so familiar that nobody has asked about it recently. In this original art afternoon, you might wonder what a welcome is meant to offer rather than repeat last year’s ritual automatically. The pleasure is discovering a different possibility inside an ordinary activity. It need not involve a dramatic reinvention, a perfect appearance or a decision about how your whole life should look.
paragraphs.zh: 芭比在本版对应重新审视熟悉事物的角度：有些安排太常见，大家很久没有问过为什么。在原创艺术下午里，你可能先想欢迎环节想带来什么，而不是自动重复去年的流程。乐趣是从普通活动里发现另一种可能，不必大改人生，也不要求完美外貌。

title.en: An invitation that asks a fresh question
title.zh: 让邀请多问一个新问题

paragraphs.en: The group is about to reuse a familiar invitation. You ask whether it tells newcomers they can bring a tiny unfinished experiment as well as a polished piece. That question changes what the invitation makes possible without declaring the earlier version wrong. Someone else may still enjoy the old format. The useful move is opening one assumption for discussion and listening to what contributors actually want to keep.
paragraphs.zh: 大家正准备沿用熟悉的邀请。你问，能不能也告诉新朋友：小小的未完成试验也可以带来，不必只带完整作品。这给邀请增加了可能性，不等于旧版本做错了。别人仍可以喜欢原形式；有用的动作是把一个预设拿出来讨论，再听大家真正想保留什么。

title.en: Curiosity beside five other contributions
title.zh: 好奇与另外五种贡献

paragraphs.en: Ken chooses an interest of his own, Gloria starts from everyday experience and President Barbie helps agree shared arrangements. Weird Barbie tries an unexpected reuse, while Allan welcomes a contribution outside the main grouping. Barbie asks which familiar assumption can be revisited. These actions can work together: a new question may need a practical agreement or an ordinary example before it becomes enjoyable. Several high counts offer several readings, without ranking originality or confidence.
paragraphs.zh: 肯选择自己的兴趣，格洛丽亚从日常经验出发，总统芭比帮助商量共同安排；怪芭比尝试意外再利用，艾伦欢迎主要分组之外的贡献。芭比则问熟悉预设能否重想。新问题也可能需要实际约定或日常例子才能变得有趣。几项高次数可以一起读，不给原创性或自信排名。

title.en: A fresh question can wait
title.zh: 新问题也可以等一等

paragraphs.en: Questioning every small convention can consume an afternoon people wanted to spend making things. Ask which assumption matters now and leave the rest alone if the group prefers. A familiar ritual can be comforting and still remain optional. Your count cannot establish exceptional curiosity or dissatisfaction with your life, and a lower count does not mean you lack imagination. Sometimes keeping the usual welcome is exactly what participants want.
paragraphs.zh: 如果每个小习惯都要重新讨论，大家原本想动手的下午也会过去。可以先问哪一个预设现在最值得谈，其余暂时放下。熟悉环节可以让人舒服，也可以保持可选。次数不证明超常好奇或对人生不满；较低次数也不等于缺想象。有时大家就是想保留原来的欢迎。

title.en: Try one editable assumption
title.zh: 试着修改一个小预设

paragraphs.en: Choose an optional creative activity and write down one assumption about how it should begin. Ask a willing collaborator whether another beginning would be enjoyable, then try a small version of either option. Afterwards, compare what the two openings allowed you to notice. You can keep the familiar approach. The experiment concerns a particular activity, rather than proving courage, discovering a hidden identity or prescribing a major personal transformation.
paragraphs.zh: 选一项可选创作活动，写下关于开场的一个预设。问愿意合作的人，换一种开场会不会有趣，再小范围试一种或两种。之后比较各自让你注意到了什么，也可以留下熟悉做法。这只探索一项活动，不证明勇气、不揭示隐藏身份，也不要求重大转变。

title.en: The Ken angle in this edition
title.zh: 本版的肯角度

paragraphs.en: Ken anchors choosing a small activity because it interests you, even when companions prefer another table. The angle concerns an ordinary leisure choice, not proving independence through separation or assigning a gendered role. You can enjoy a friend’s company and still spend part of an afternoon differently. The important detail is recognising what you want to try now without needing it to be the most popular or impressive option.
paragraphs.zh: 肯在本版对应按自己的兴趣选一项小活动，即使同伴更喜欢另一桌。角度关乎普通休闲选择，不靠分开来证明独立，也不规定性别角色。你可以喜欢与朋友相处，同时把下午的一部分花在不同内容上。重点是认出现在想试什么，不必选最热门或最耀眼的一项。

title.en: Two workshops and a later meeting
title.zh: 两个工作坊，之后再相聚

paragraphs.en: A friend is keen on collage while you want to try a simple sound-making table. You say which activity interests you and suggest meeting afterwards to show each other what happened. Neither choice needs to defeat the other. You might change your mind after looking at the materials, or choose a shorter session. The scene allows shared company and separate interests without turning a small preference into a test of friendship.
paragraphs.zh: 朋友想拼贴，你却想试简单的声音创作桌。你说出自己的兴趣，提议之后碰面，分享各自做了什么。两个选择不必分胜负；看过材料后也可以改主意、缩短参与时间。场景让相处与不同兴趣并存，不把一个小偏好变成友谊考验。

title.en: An own choice beside five other contributions
title.zh: 自己的选择与另外五种贡献

paragraphs.en: Barbie reconsiders a familiar assumption, Gloria draws from everyday experience and President Barbie agrees a shared plan. Weird Barbie recombines spare materials while Allan makes room for an unusual contribution. Ken asks what he actually wants to try. These contributions can coexist; a shared plan can include time apart. A tie offers several ways to take part rather than a competition between needing people and needing independence.
paragraphs.zh: 芭比重新想熟悉预设，格洛丽亚从日常找素材，总统芭比商量共同安排；怪芭比重组闲置材料，艾伦为特别贡献留位置。肯问自己真正想试什么。这些动作能共存，共同安排也能包含分开活动的时间。并列不是在“需要别人”和“需要独立”之间分胜负。

title.en: Choosing differently need not become a rule
title.zh: 选择不同不必变成规则

paragraphs.en: Doing something different just to avoid agreement can be as restrictive as always following the group. Check whether you like the activity itself, including the possibility that you genuinely prefer the popular table today. You can explain a choice briefly without defending your whole identity. Your count cannot establish relationship dependence or self-esteem, and a lower count does not mean you lack interests of your own or need to leave a relationship.
paragraphs.zh: 为了不同而不同，也可能像总跟着大家一样受限。可以问自己是否喜欢活动本身，包括今天确实想选热门桌的可能。解释选择只需几句话，不必捍卫整个人生身份。次数不判断关系依赖或自尊；较低次数不表示没有自己的兴趣，更不意味着应该离开某段关系。

title.en: Try a small preference without a performance
title.zh: 试一个无需证明什么的小偏好

paragraphs.en: At a voluntary event, choose one available activity on its own merits and tell companions when you would like to reconnect. Notice whether making that small choice was enjoyable and whether the timing worked for everyone. You may choose the same table next time. This is feedback on one afternoon’s preference, not a measure of autonomy, a relationship assessment or a prescription to change the people around you.
paragraphs.zh: 在自愿活动里，单看内容选一项可参加的活动，再告诉同伴想何时碰面。观察这个小选择是否有趣、时间是否适合彼此。下次也可以选同一桌。这是一个下午的偏好反馈，不测自主性，不评关系，也不要求换掉身边的人。

title.en: The Gloria angle in this edition
title.zh: 本版的格洛丽亚角度

paragraphs.en: Gloria names bringing an ordinary detail from your own day into a creative activity. A bus-stop colour, a brief welcome or the way a cup sits on a table can be enough material. The angle does not require a grand story, personal disclosure or an impressive artistic identity. It starts with something you noticed and asks what you would enjoy making from it in this small shared setting.
paragraphs.zh: 格洛丽亚在本版对应把自己一天中的普通细节带进创作。车站的一种颜色、一句简单欢迎、杯子放在桌上的样子，都可能够用。不需要宏大故事、私密披露或耀眼的艺术身份。角度从你注意到的一件事开始，再问愿意在这个小场景里把它做成什么。

title.en: A waiting moment becomes a tiny drawing
title.zh: 等待的片刻变成小画

paragraphs.en: You remember a patch of afternoon light while waiting for a friend. You make a small drawing about its shape rather than describe the friend’s private circumstances. Another contributor sees a different association, and the two can sit beside each other. The everyday starting point offers material without claiming that the drawing reveals your feelings completely, explains another person or has to become a lesson for the whole group.
paragraphs.zh: 你记得等朋友时见过的一片午后光影，于是画它的形状，不讲朋友的私人情况。另一位参与者有不同联想，两种读法可以并排。日常起点提供素材，不声称画完全揭示了你的感受，不解释别人，也不一定要变成全组的道理。

title.en: An ordinary detail beside five other contributions
title.zh: 日常细节与另外五种贡献

paragraphs.en: Barbie opens a familiar assumption to a new question, Ken chooses an interest and President Barbie helps agree shared arrangements. Weird Barbie reuses an overlooked object while Allan welcomes a small unusual contribution. Gloria supplies material from lived everyday moments. None ranks maturity, emotional depth or artistic ability. Several high counts can describe several contributions to one afternoon without claiming you must explain everyone else’s experience or turn private difficulties into creative work.
paragraphs.zh: 芭比给熟悉预设加一个新问题，肯选兴趣，总统芭比商量共同安排；怪芭比再用被忽略的物件，艾伦欢迎特别的小贡献。格洛丽亚提供来自日常片刻的素材。不排名成熟、感受深度或艺术能力。几个高次数可描述同一下午的不同贡献，不要求解释别人，更不要求把私密困难做成作品。

title.en: Your experience can remain yours
title.zh: 经验也可以留给自己

paragraphs.en: A shared activity can invite more explanation than you want to offer. You can use a neutral detail, invent something entirely or keep a piece private. A small drawing does not need an autobiographical account to deserve a place. Your count cannot establish emotional insight, caregiving capacity or parental identity, and a lower count does not mean your ordinary life lacks richness or that you are unable to make meaningful work.
paragraphs.zh: 共同活动有时会引出比你想提供的更多解释。你可以选中性细节、完全虚构，或把作品留给自己。一幅小画不靠自传式说明才配被展示。次数不确立情感洞察、照护能力或父母身份；较低次数也不表示生活贫乏，或做不出有意义的作品。

title.en: Try a detail you are comfortable sharing
title.zh: 试一个愿意分享的日常细节

paragraphs.en: Choose an ordinary, non-private detail you noticed today and make a tiny creative response using materials already available. Share only what you want, if anything, and ask a willing collaborator what the piece lets them notice. You can keep their reading separate from your own. The exercise explores a creative starting point, not emotional diagnosis, a test of empathy or an obligation to make personal experience useful to others.
paragraphs.zh: 选一个今天见过、没有隐私负担的普通细节，用现有材料做一个小回应。只分享愿意分享的部分，也可以不分享。问自愿伙伴作品让他们注意到了什么，并保留与自己不同的读法。练习探索创作起点，不作情绪诊断、不测共情，也不要求经验必须对别人有用。

title.en: President Barbie
title.zh: 总统芭比（President Barbie）

title.en: The President Barbie angle in this edition
title.zh: 本版的总统芭比角度

paragraphs.en: President Barbie anchors making a few shared arrangements with the people who will use them. At the art afternoon, that might mean agreeing a turn-taking plan for one crowded table. The angle is about a voluntary, changeable agreement, not authority attached to a title. A useful arrangement makes participation easier to understand while allowing contributors to question it, choose a smaller part or leave an optional activity without being judged.
paragraphs.zh: 总统芭比在本版对应与使用安排的人一起商量几项共同约定。在艺术下午里，也许是给一张拥挤桌子约定轮流方式。角度关乎自愿、可变的协议，不是头衔带来的权威。有用安排让参与更清楚，同时容许提问、选择小份任务，或离开可选活动而不受评判。

title.en: One corner, two enjoyable activities
title.zh: 一个角落，两项有趣活动

paragraphs.en: Two groups want the same corner, and both can explain what they hoped to make there. You help put those needs into a short timetable and ask whether the proposed order works. The timetable remains editable when someone arrives late or wants less time. The contribution is helping this particular afternoon run, not deciding that the loudest group deserves the space or requiring anyone to accept your first solution.
paragraphs.zh: 两组都想用同一个角落，也都能说清想在那里做什么。你帮忙把需要放进一个短时间表，再问顺序是否合适。有人迟到或只想少用一会时，时间表仍可改。贡献是让这个下午好进行，不是判最响亮的一组应该得地盘，也不要求接受你的第一个方案。

title.en: Agreement beside five other contributions
title.zh: 约定与另外五种贡献

paragraphs.en: Barbie rethinks a familiar assumption, Ken chooses an interest and Gloria offers an everyday starting point. Weird Barbie finds a surprising reuse, while Allan leaves room for an unusual small contribution. President Barbie helps those activities share time and space. An agreement can protect differences rather than erase them. Several high counts do not establish political ability, leadership quality or a duty to take charge of every gathering you attend.
paragraphs.zh: 芭比重想熟悉预设，肯选兴趣，格洛丽亚给日常起点；怪芭比找到意外再利用，艾伦给特别的小贡献留位置。总统芭比帮助这些活动共用时间和空间。约定可以保护不同，而非抹平不同。几项高次数不证明政治能力、领导水平，也不要求在每次聚会都负责。

title.en: A plan can be smaller than the event
title.zh: 安排可以比活动更简单

paragraphs.en: Not every small choice needs a meeting or a rule. Ask which shared resource actually needs an agreement and leave individual preferences alone. You can also decline the coordinating role if you wanted to spend the afternoon making something. Your count cannot establish authority, fairness or political beliefs, and a lower count does not mean you are unable to cooperate. Sometimes a single clear time boundary is enough for everyone to get started.
paragraphs.zh: 不是每个小选择都需要会议或规则。可以问哪项共享资源真需要约定，其余个人偏好留给个人。若本想来创作，也能不接协调角色。次数不确立权威、公平或政治信念；较低次数不表示不能合作。有时一个清楚的时间边界就够大家开工。

title.en: Try an agreement people can revise
title.zh: 试一项人人能修改的约定

paragraphs.en: For a voluntary creative session, identify one resource that participants want to share and ask each willing person what would make it workable. Agree only the few details needed, including how to change them later. Afterwards, ask whether the arrangement helped or simply added coordination. This explores one practical contribution, not a leadership score, a political assessment or permission to impose decisions on people outside the activity.
paragraphs.zh: 自愿创作时，找一项大家想共用的资源，问愿意参与的人怎样才方便。只约必要细节，也约好之后怎样修改。结束后问安排是否有帮助，还是只多了协调。这探索一项实际贡献，不测领导、不评政治，也不授权把决定强加给活动之外的人。

title.en: The Weird Barbie angle in this edition
title.zh: 本版的怪芭比角度

paragraphs.en: Weird Barbie anchors trying an unexpected use for materials that did not fit the original plan. The name identifies a selected film character; it does not label you as strange, damaged or socially outside. In this original afternoon, two spare paper shapes might become a playful new object. The pleasure lies in the combination you choose to explore, without a requirement to be shocking, ingenious or unlike everyone else.
paragraphs.zh: 怪芭比在本版对应为原计划用不上的材料试一个意外用途。名称只指选定电影角色，不把你标成古怪、受损或被排斥的人。原创下午里，两块闲纸形状可能变成有趣新物。乐趣在愿意探索的组合，不要求惊人、天才或必须与所有人不同。

title.en: The tear becomes part of the design
title.zh: 让裂口成为设计的一部分

paragraphs.en: A decoration tears into an interesting outline. Before changing it, you ask its maker whether they would like to try incorporating the tear into another shape. They may prefer to repair the original, keep the altered piece or put it aside. The unexpected possibility is an invitation, not a verdict that damage is beautiful or that everyone must make creative use of experiences they would rather leave alone.
paragraphs.zh: 一件装饰裂出有趣轮廓。你先问作者，愿不愿意试着把裂口并入另一个形状。对方也可以修回原样、留下改变后的样子，或先放一边。意外可能性是一份邀请，不是断言损坏就美，也不要求把不想碰的经历都用来创作。

title.en: Reuse beside five other contributions
title.zh: 再利用与另外五种贡献

paragraphs.en: Barbie asks a fresh question about the familiar, Ken chooses an interest and Gloria starts with an everyday observation. President Barbie agrees shared arrangements while Allan welcomes a small off-theme contribution. Weird Barbie tries another use for an overlooked object. The angles can cooperate without ranking creativity, beauty or originality. A tie does not mean you need an outsider identity or should keep possessions and projects that you no longer want.
paragraphs.zh: 芭比为熟悉事物提新问题，肯选兴趣，格洛丽亚从日常观察开始；总统芭比约共同安排，艾伦欢迎主题外的小贡献。怪芭比则试被忽略物件的另一用途。角度可合作，不排创造力、美或原创性。并列不要求当局外人，也不要求保留已经不想要的物品或项目。

title.en: An unexpected idea can still be declined
title.zh: 意外点子也能被拒绝

paragraphs.en: An inventive reuse is not automatically what a maker wants for their piece. Ask before altering shared materials and accept a simple refusal without making it a judgment about imagination. You can enjoy a conventional object too. Your count cannot establish neurodivergence, trauma, social rejection or artistic talent, and a lower count does not mean you are dull. An afternoon can be successful without producing a surprising new use for anything.
paragraphs.zh: 巧妙再利用未必是作者想要的方向。改共有材料前先问，接受简单拒绝，不把它变成想象力评判。你也可以喜欢常规物件。次数不确立神经差异、创伤、社交排斥或艺术天赋；较低次数也不表示无趣。没有发现任何意外用途，下午仍然可以很好。

title.en: Try a combination that can come apart
title.zh: 试一个还能拆开的组合

paragraphs.en: Take two spare materials whose owners have offered them for a voluntary activity. Try a small reversible combination and ask what, if anything, makes it enjoyable. Keep it, separate it or return to the original plan without needing to justify the choice. This is a playful material experiment, not a test of resilience, an interpretation of difficult experiences or a requirement to make something unusual in order to belong.
paragraphs.zh: 选两份主人愿意用于自愿活动的闲置材料，试一个能拆回的组合，问它是否有趣、有趣在哪里。可以留、拆开或回原计划，不必为选择辩护。这是材料小实验，不测韧性、不解读困难经历，也不要求做出特别东西才配属于这里。

title.en: The Allan angle in this edition
title.zh: 本版的艾伦角度

paragraphs.en: Allan anchors making room for a small contribution that does not fit the main grouping. At this original art afternoon, someone might bring one unusual object rather than join the large shared picture. The angle concerns offering a clear optional welcome, not rescuing people, claiming to understand their private feelings or turning a supporting character into a fixed role you must occupy. A modest place can be enough without asking anyone to change.
paragraphs.zh: 艾伦在本版对应为主要分组之外的小贡献留位置。在原创艺术下午里，有人可能只带一件特别物件，不加入大幅共画。角度是给清楚、可选的欢迎，不是拯救别人、声称懂其私密感受，也不把配角变成你必须担任的固定角色。有时一个小位置就够，不必要求谁先改变。

title.en: One small piece can be enough
title.zh: 一件小作品也可以足够

paragraphs.en: A visitor wants to show a tiny off-theme piece and then go. You point out an available place, explain the time boundary and let its maker decide whether to use it. You do not promise that everyone will love the piece or ask for a longer performance in return. The contribution remains theirs, and your welcome does not create an obligation to stay, explain a personal story or join the whole event.
paragraphs.zh: 一位来访者只想展示一件偏离主题的小作品，然后离开。你指出可用位置、说明时间边界，让作者决定是否使用。不承诺人人喜欢，也不要求回报更长表演。作品仍属于对方；欢迎不会制造留下、自述身世或参加全程的义务。

title.en: Welcome beside five other contributions
title.zh: 欢迎与另外五种贡献

paragraphs.en: Barbie reconsiders a familiar assumption, Ken chooses an interest and Gloria offers an everyday creative starting point. President Barbie agrees shared arrangements, while Weird Barbie tries a surprising reuse. Allan leaves room for a contribution outside the main theme. These actions can support the same afternoon without ranking kindness or social skill. Several high counts do not assign you responsibility for including everyone or making every group feel comfortable.
paragraphs.zh: 芭比重想熟悉预设，肯选兴趣，格洛丽亚给日常创作起点；总统芭比商量共同安排，怪芭比试意外用途。艾伦给主主题之外的贡献留位置。这些动作可支持同一下午，不排名善良或社交技术。几项高次数不让你负责接纳所有人，也不让你负责每个小组都舒服。

title.en: A welcome needs real limits
title.zh: 欢迎也需要真实边界

paragraphs.en: An open invitation can promise more time, attention or space than the group actually has. State what is available and let the maker choose whether it suits them. You can welcome a small piece without abandoning your own project or changing the event for everyone. Your count cannot establish selflessness, social exclusion or a supporting identity, and a lower count does not mean unkindness. Limits can make an invitation easier to understand and decline.
paragraphs.zh: 开放邀请有时会承诺超过实际的时间、关注或空间。可以说清有什么，让作者决定合适否。欢迎小作品不必放弃自己的项目，也不必替全组改活动。次数不确立无私、被排斥或辅助型身份；较低次数不表示不友善。边界反而让邀请更容易理解，也更容易拒绝。

title.en: Try one specific, optional invitation
title.zh: 试一次具体、可选的邀请

paragraphs.en: At a voluntary creative gathering, offer one available space for a contribution that falls outside the main theme. Explain the practical limit and ask whether its maker wants it, without requesting a personal explanation. Afterwards, check whether the invitation was clear and whether your own activity still had room. This explores one small hosting choice, not empathy, moral worth, belonging as a person or a duty to absorb other people’s needs.
paragraphs.zh: 自愿创作聚会中，给主题之外的一份贡献提供一个确实可用的位置。说明实际限制，问作者愿意否，不索要个人解释。之后核邀请是否清楚、自己的活动是否仍有空间。这探索一个小小的接待选择，不测共情、道德价值或人的归属，也不派吸收他人需要的义务。
